payload.name: Montra
payload.description: 告诉你的代理人要改变什么
payload.summaryOriginal: Show your agent what to change
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Montra turns screenshots and screen recordings into agent ready tasks with the right visual context attached. Share them with your team, send them to tools like ChatGPT and Codex, or automatically create tickets in your issue tracker of choice in a few clicks.
payload.longDescription: Montra将屏幕截图和屏幕录制转化为代理准备任务,并附有正确的视觉背景,与您的团队分享,将其发送到诸如ChatGPT和Codex等工具,或在几点点点击中自动创建您选择的问题跟踪器中的门票。

payload.name: Coval
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.
payload.longDescription: Coval帮助团队检查人工智能代理,测试集,个人,指标和评估运行;创建和改进评估资源;推出评估;并要求Sofia在他们的Coval组织中进行只读分析。

payload.name: RideDesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur,
  taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs
  each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under
  their own brand.

  This plugin serves RideDesk's developer documentation as queryable tools,
  so an agent can pull the exact API contract while building an operator's
  booking website: the three-call quote → book → checkout flow, embeddable
  booking widgets, visitor attribution, live chat, the customer portal, and
  each account's own MCP booking server for AI-agent bookings.

  It is read-only and requires no account or authentication. Actual quotes
  and bookings happen on an operator's own domain, never through this
  plugin — and prices are always computed server-side from the operator's
  own rate card, never by an agent.

  Typical uses: ask for the integration brief before building a booking
  site, look up the checkout contract, fetch widget embed snippets for a
  specific domain, or search the docs for captcha, attribution and
  customer-portal details.
payload.longDescription:
RideDesk是机场接送,司机,出租车和汽车租赁运营商的预订和发送软件 - 传输管理软件在每个运营商的预订,报价,司机,发票和付款的自己的品牌下运行。

此插件将RideDesk的开发人员文档作为可查询的工具,以便代理人在构建运营商的预订网站时可以提取准确的API合同:三通报价 →预订 →支出流程,嵌入式预订工具,访问者分配,现场聊天,客户端,以及每个帐户的MCP预订服务器用于AI代理预订。

实际报价和预订发生在运营商自己的领域,从来没有通过这个插件 - 价格总是从运营商自己的报价卡计算服务器侧,从来没有由代理人。

典型的用途:在建立预订网站之前请求整合简要信息,查找支出合同,为特定域收集嵌入维吉片片段,或搜索文件以获取captcha、分配和客户门户细节。

payload.name: GEO Tool Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GEO Tool Check helps users assess whether a public page can be read, understood, and cited by AI search systems. It scores page readiness, checks whether major AI crawlers are blocked, and evaluates draft passages for citability. Checks run without an account or API key and use the same scoring logic as geo-tool.com.
payload.longDescription: GEO Tool Check帮助用户评估是否可以通过AI搜索系统读取、理解和引用公共页面。它得分了页面准备,检查是否被阻止了主要AI扫描器,并评估了可读性草案段落。

payload.name: Smooth Bundle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Smooth Bundle to manage CDN projects and assets. List projects, inspect asset metadata, upload files, delete assets with confirmation, purge stale asset records, and review usage through your Smooth Bundle account.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Smooth Bundle 以管理 CDN 项目和资产. 列出项目,检查资产元数据,上传文件,通过确认删除资产,清除旧资产记录,并通过您的 Smooth Bundle 帐户审查使用情况。

payload.name: Replay.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Time travel debugging
payload.longDescription: 时间旅行调试

payload.name: Upstash Redis
payload.description: Redis 及其他 Upstash 产品
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Upstash resources from ChatGPT through the hosted Upstash MCP server (OAuth on first use): create and inspect Redis databases and run commands on them, publish QStash messages and manage schedules, build Vector and Search indexes, and drive Box sandboxes and Blob storage. Credentials stay on the server and are returned only when you ask for them.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的 Upstash MCP 服务器(OAuth 首次使用)从 ChatGPT 管理您的 Upstash 资源:创建和检查 Redis 数据库并在其上运行命令,发布 QStash 消息和管理时间表,构建 Vector 和 Search 索引,并驱动 Box 沙盒和 Blob 存储。

payload.name: BrowserStack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage test cases, execute manual or automated tests, debug failures, and get suggested fixes.

Test from any AI tool: Connect the BrowserStack Test Platform to what you already such as IDEs, LLMs, or agentic workflows

Test with natural language: Create test cases and runs, launch sessions on real browsers and devices, run accessibility and visual checks, pull failure logs, and get AI root cause analysis, all from plain English prompts.

Less context switching: Keep all project context in one place and trigger actions directly from your IDE or LLM.
payload.longDescription:
管理测试案例,执行手动或自动测试,调试故障,并获得建议的修复。

从任何 AI 工具进行测试:将 BrowserStack 测试平台连接到您已经拥有的工具,如 IDEs、LLM 或代理工作流程

使用自然语言进行测试:创建测试案例和运行,在真实的浏览器和设备上启动会话,运行可访问性和视觉检查,提取故障日志,并获得AI根源原因分析,所有这些都来自简单的英语提示。

更少的背景切换:将所有项目背景放在一个地方,并直接从您的IDE或LLM中启动操作。

payload.name: DB Fiddle
payload.description: 运行 SQL 没有离开聊天
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The DB Fiddle plugin lets users run SQL against a disposable sandbox environment, directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Create database schemas, load sample data, execute queries, and inspect real database results without connecting to a production database or external system.

The sandbox provides the perfect place for ChatGPT and Codex to iterate on queries and safely debug SQL, reproduce database issues, validate queries and experiment with any of the supported database engines.

Supported database engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and more.

Note: A db-fiddle.com PRO subscription is required to use this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
DB Fiddle 插件允许用户在可一次性沙盒环境中运行 SQL,直接来自 ChatGPT 和 Codex。

创建数据库方案,加载样本数据,执行查询,并检查实际数据库结果,而无需连接到生产数据库或外部系统。

沙盒为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 提供了一个完美的场所,可以重复查询并安全地调试 SQL,复制数据库问题,验证查询并尝试任何受支持的数据库引擎。

支持的数据库引擎:PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQLite等。

注意:需要使用 db-fiddle.com PRO 订阅才能使用此插件。

payload.name: PayU Builder MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search PayU's official documentation, browse the payment integration catalog by platform and language, and fetch production-ready code snippets for Web, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Cordova, and API integrations. Supports 9 programming languages with ready-to-use examples for UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, EMI, and tokenization.
payload.longDescription: 搜索PayU的官方文档,根据平台和语言浏览支付集成目录,并获取Web,iOS,Android,React Native,Flutter,Cordova和API集成的生产准备代码片段。

payload.name: DataBlue
payload.description: 为AI代理人提供实时网络数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Live web data for AI agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DataBlue is a live web data layer for AI agents. In ChatGPT, users can search the web, scrape one or many public pages, map and crawl websites, extract structured facts, and query DataBlue's catalog of structured data APIs.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中,用户可以搜索网络,扫描一个或多个公共页面,地图和扫描网站,提取结构化事实,并查询DataBlue的结构化数据API目录。

payload.name: Rubikpara AI Asistan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rubikpara ürünleri, API entegrasyonları, dokümantasyon ve hata kodları hakkında resmi bilgilere erişmenizi sağlayan AI asistanı.

payload.name: Appwrite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Appwrite's plugin helps users explore their projects, inspect databases and storage, and manage users, functions, messaging, and sites through ChatGPT. Discover available operations, review required parameters, and execute changes with write confirmation. Search official Appwrite documentation for concepts and implementation guidance when documentation search is enabled.
payload.longDescription: Appwrite 的插件帮助用户探索他们的项目,检查数据库和存储,并通过 ChatGPT 管理用户、功能、消息和网站. 发现可用的操作,查看所需的参数,并通过写确认执行更改。

payload.name: Postman
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Equip Codex with specialized Postman skills for the complete API lifecycle. Discover, design, test, document, mock, monitor, and improve APIs through agent-friendly, filesystem-first workflows
payload.longDescription: 让 Codex 拥有专门的 Postman 技能,以实现完整的 API 生命周期,探索、设计、测试、文档、模仿、监视并通过代理友好、文件系统优先的工作流程来改进 API。

payload.name: Unblocked
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.
payload.longDescription:
Unblocked 是代理软件开发的背景层,它在您的代码、对话、问题、文档、产品和生产系统中提供理由,以便代理人能够以更少的人类干预的方式正确地完成工作。

编码代理人知道代码,他们不知道为什么它是这样写的,两个矛盾的文件中哪个是当前的,什么是票据决定,或者生产正在做什么。

一个MCP服务器取代了十几个. 文本在到达代理人之前被排序,压缩和组装到服务器侧,因此代理人因高质量的输入而产生了理由. 结果:可靠的代码反映了您的团队如何实际构建软件,产生了更少的代币和更少的后退。

通过 MCP 或通过 Unblocked CLI 和 API 与 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、GitHub Copilot 和 Codex 合作,连接到 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、Microsoft Teams、Jira、Linear、Confluence、Notion、Google Drive、Sentry、Datadog 等等。

payload.name: Armature
payload.description: 检查 MCP 代理活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Armature helps developers inspect configured MCP servers, review recorded agent sessions and use cases, investigate recurring issues, and report missing app capabilities through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Armature 帮助开发人员检查配置的 MCP 服务器,审查记录的代理会话和使用案例,调查重复出现的问题,并通过 ChatGPT 报告缺失的应用功能。

payload.name: Artie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Artie helps data teams set up, inspect, and operate change-data-capture pipelines from databases and APIs into warehouses. Use it to list pipelines and connectors, inspect table metadata, configure replication, monitor lag, and manage supporting infrastructure like SSH tunnels and PrivateLink connections—all within your authenticated Artie environment.
payload.longDescription: Artie 帮助数据团队设置、检查和操作从数据库和 API 到仓库的更改数据捕获管道. 使用它来列出管道和连接器,检查表元数据,配置复制,监控延迟,并管理支持基础设施,如 SSH 隧道和 PrivateLink 连接 - 所有这些都在您的经过验证的 Artie 环境中。

payload.name: Gateway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gateway lets users manage owned Linux and Windows OpenSSH servers from ChatGPT: inspect health and configuration, run auditable commands and typed administrative operations, transfer files, and follow durable jobs.
payload.longDescription: Gateway 允许用户从 ChatGPT 管理 Linux 和 Windows OpenSSH 服务器:检查状态和配置,运行可审核的命令和输入的管理操作,传输文件,并跟踪可持续的任务。

payload.name: BoxToPlay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your BoxToPlay game servers, VPS, and web hosting directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Manage Minecraft hosting, BungeeCord and Velocity proxies, TeamSpeak voice servers, VPS, and hosted websites from one place.

Depending on the service, you can:
• Monitor live service status, players, performance, health, and logs
• Investigate crashes, startup failures, and plugin, mod, or proxy issues using logs and health checks
• Manage files, settings, backups, firewall rules, and DNS records
• Start, stop, and restart services, and track long-running operations

Access is restricted to services in your authenticated BoxToPlay account and the permissions granted to the app.
payload.longDescription:
直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 管理您的 BoxToPlay 游戏服务器、VPS 和 Web 托管。

从一个地方管理Minecraft托管,BungeeCord和Velocity代理,TeamSpeak语音服务器,VPS和托管网站。

根据服务,您可以: • 监控实时服务状态、玩家、性能、健康和日志 • 使用日志和健康检查调查故障、启动故障和插件、mod 或代理问题 • 管理文件、设置、备份、防火墙规则和 DNS 记录 • 启动、停止和重新启动服务,并跟踪长期运行的操作

访问仅限于您身份验证的 BoxToPlay 帐户中的服务和授予该应用程序的权限。

payload.name: Rootly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Rootly to investigate incidents, summarize alerts and timelines, review on-call schedules and escalation paths, and manage incident follow-up work.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到 Rootly 以调查事件,总结警报和时间表,审查通话时间表和升级路径,并管理事件后续工作。

payload.name: Data Dolphin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The DataDolphin connects ChatGPT to Dolphin Sistemas' structured knowledge base — including projects, documents, architecture rules, and agent instructions. With a single connection, you can query implementation context, retrieve project specifications, and access technical documentation in real time. All access is protected by OAuth 2.0 via Keycloak and restricted to read-only operations, ensuring safe and auditable use by AI agents.
payload.longDescription: DataDolphin 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Dolphin Systems 的结构化知识库,包括项目、文档、架构规则和代理指令. 通过单个连接,您可以查询实施情况,获取项目规格,并实时访问技术文档。

payload.name: elmah.io MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: elmah.io MCP helps users inspect their elmah.io account from ChatGPT by listing accessible logs and organizations, analyzing recent and frequent log messages, reviewing deployments, checking uptime and heartbeat status, and retrieving detailed error context for debugging production issues.
payload.longDescription: elmah.io MCP 帮助用户通过列出可访问的日志和组织,分析最近和频繁的日志消息,审查部署,检查工作时间和心跳状态,并获取详细的错误背景来调试生产问题。

payload.name: Strix
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Strix brings AI penetration testing and vulnerability management into ChatGPT. Review recent tests, prioritize open findings by severity, and inspect evidence and remediation steps. Start tests against your authorized web applications, APIs, and repositories; retest findings; and open fix pull requests or tickets through connected integrations. Check pull request security reviews and supply-chain findings, manage recurring schedules and assets, and summarize your workspace's security activity. Sign in with your Strix account using OAuth. Access follows your Strix workspace role and resource permissions. Starting tests, retests, reviews, and other security workflows may use Strix credits and send traffic to the selected targets. Some capabilities require an eligible Strix plan.

payload.name: QtMesh Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QtMesh Cloud helps users inspect 3D asset quality from ChatGPT. Users can list their projects, review scan summaries, inspect findings and scan reports, check quality gate settings, update owner-scoped quality gates, and control whether a project's public report is visible.
payload.longDescription: QtMesh Cloud 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 检查 3D 资产质量,用户可以列出他们的项目,查看扫描摘要,检查结果和扫描报告,检查质量网关设置,更新所有者范围内的质量网关,并控制项目的公共报告是否可见。

payload.name: Openlayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Openlayer helps teams inspect AI projects, data sources, traces, tests, evaluation results, and governance controls, and manage private workspace resources through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Openlayer 帮助团队检查人工智能项目、数据源、线索、测试、评估结果和治理控制,并通过 ChatGPT 管理私人工作空间资源。

payload.name: Unbounce - Classic Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Unbounce account to create and edit landing pages, add A/B test variants, set traffic splits, and check page performance without leaving the chat. 
Describe the page you want and Unbounce will build it; ask for a new variant, a headline change, or a conversion report and it's handled in your account.
Works with your existing Unbounce pages, domains, and page groups. Requires an Unbounce account and the Classic Builder.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的 Unbounce 帐户以创建和编辑定位页面,添加 A/B 测试变体,设置流量分布,并检查页面性能而不离开聊天。 描述您想要的页面,Unbounce 将构建它;请求一个新的变体,标题更改或转换报告,并在您的帐户中处理。

payload.name: Greptile
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI code review agent for GitHub and GitLab. View Greptile's PR review comments, run reviews on your working branch, and search your organization's knowledge base and coding patterns, directly from Codex.
payload.longDescription: 查看Greptile的PR评论评论,对您的工作分支进行评论,并直接从Codex搜索您的组织的知识库和编码模式。

payload.name: Embrasure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Embrasure helps ChatGPT and Codex investigate silent data failures without querying arbitrary warehouse rows. Inspect table health and Scout evidence, trace table- and column-level lineage, identify downstream services and owners, and understand blast radius before a change. Reads respect workspace permissions. Scout changes always require preview and explicit approval.
payload.longDescription: Embrasure 可帮助 ChatGPT 和 Codex 调查无声数据故障,而无需查询任意仓库行。检查表健康和扫描证据,跟踪表和列级线程,识别下游服务和所有者,并在更改之前了解爆炸半径。

payload.name: SCVD x402 Verifier
payload.description: 检查 x402 门和收据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SCVD x402 Verifier checks payment challenges without paying, verifies signed x402 offers and receipts, reads recorded endpoint readiness, explains defect classes, and checks SCVD artifact signatures. Results describe evidence and limits; they do not establish delivery or guarantee a provider. All tools are free and no wallet or login is required. Calls record usage statistics. Readiness lookups for eligible hosts with no recorded probe add the hostname and ask count to a public queue for a later discovery sweep; caller identity is not included in that queue.
payload.longDescription: SCVD x402 Verifier 检查付款挑战而无需付款,验证签名的 x402 报价和收据,读取记录的终端准备,解释缺陷类,检查 SCVD 文物签名。结果描述了证据和限制;他们不建立交付或保证提供商。所有工具都是免费的,无需钱包或登录。呼叫记录使用统计数据。对于没有记录的探测器的合格主机,准备查询添加主机名,并要求向公共排队进行后续发现扫描;呼叫者身份不包括在那个排队中。

payload.name: Limrun
payload.description: 在云模拟器上测试应用程序
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want.
payload.longDescription: Limrun 在云中为您的代理提供 iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器. 请求设备并在几秒钟内准备好,如果您想要的话,您的应用程序将预先安装。

payload.name: qBraid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: qBraid helps users explore quantum devices, validate and simulate circuits, submit quantum jobs, and inspect results. Users can manage cloud compute, inspect notebooks and software environments, browse qBook courses, enroll in courses, and review learner progress when authorized. It also supports organization membership and credit workflows, billing summaries, and support requests. Credit purchases and course creation or redeployment are unavailable through this app. Some actions spend existing credits, change access, or send messages, and support content can be shared with support services.
payload.longDescription: qBraid 帮助用户探索量子设备,验证和模拟电路,提交量子工作并检查结果. 用户可以管理云计算,检查笔记本和软件环境,浏览 qBook 课程,注册课程,并在授权时审查学习者进度。 它还支持组织会员和信用工作流程,计费总结和支持请求。 信用购买和课程创建或重新部署是通过此应用程序不可用。

payload.name: LabWired
payload.description: 在虚拟芯片上运行固件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required. The same firmware binary that flashes to real silicon runs in the simulator, so results are reproducible enough to debug and to gate CI on. LabWired validates your wiring before it runs, lists the boards and components it supports, compiles firmware from source, and opens a live lab view embedded in ChatGPT where you can see GPIO, serial output, and peripherals respond in real time.
payload.longDescription: LabWired 运行真正的嵌入式固件在微控制器(ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V 和 ESP32)的确定性模拟上,直接在对话中。 选择一个板,与传感器,显示器和巴士连接一个 MCU,编译固件,并在您可以观看的交互式硬件实验室中运行 - 无需物理板。 相同的固件二进制在模拟器中运行,所以结果足够可复制来调试和打开 CI。 LabWired 在运行前验证您的连接,列出它所支持的板和组件,从源头编译固件,并打开嵌入 ChatGPT 中的实时实验室视图,您可以看到 GPIO,系列输出和外部设备实时响应。

payload.name: Better Design
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Better Design gives AI coding agents a design-engineering layer for frontend work.

Design Intelligence mode loads UI principles before the agent writes UI code, then asks the agent to self-review against accessibility, visual design, motion, content, and comprehension rules. It helps catch issues like weak hierarchy, inaccessible controls, distracting motion, unclear copy, and missing reduced-motion behavior before code is presented.

Scaffold mode lets an agent install a complete shadcn-compatible visual system: tokens, globals, and component source. Better Design can also generate a new custom design system from a natural-language prompt and return a shadcn install command for the resulting registry.

The MCP server exposes tools for finding and generating design systems, loading UI/UX and React Native guidance, reviewing interface quality, extracting existing CSS tokens, and installing icon components. Tools are served from a public HTTPS endpoint and authenticated with OAuth for hosted ChatGPT and Codex use.
payload.longDescription:
更好的设计为AI编码代理提供了前端工作的设计工程层。

Design Intelligence 模式在代理人编写 UI 代码之前加载 UI 原则,然后要求代理人对可访问性、视觉设计、运动、内容和理解规则进行自我审查。

Scaffold 模式允许代理人安装完整的 shadcn 兼容的视觉系统:代币、全球和组件源. Better Design 还可以从自然语言提示中生成新的自定义设计系统,并返回由此产生的注册表的 shadcn 安装命令。

MCP 服务器暴露了用于寻找和生成设计系统的工具,加载 UI/UX 和 React Native 指导,审查接口质量,提取现有 CSS 代币,并安装图标组件。

payload.name: Tiniest Cloud
payload.description: 使用 Sign-in 部署 Web 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tiniest Cloud hosts static web apps and gives each one sign-in, per-user storage, realtime, push notifications, scheduled jobs and a language model with nothing to configure. From a conversation you can deploy a folder and get a live URL, share the app with someone by email, roll back to an earlier version, connect a third-party API without putting its key in the page, schedule recurring work, and put an app on your own domain.
payload.longDescription: Tiniest Cloud 主持静态 Web 应用程序,每个应用程序都提供一个登录、用户存储、实时、推送通知、日程工作和一个没有任何配置的语言模型。从一个对话中,您可以部署一个文件夹并获得直播 URL,通过电子邮件与某人共享应用程序,回滚到以前的版本,连接第三方 API 而无需将其钥匙放在页面中,计划重复工作,并将应用程序放到自己的域。

payload.name: AiAkiv Memory
payload.description: AI 代理商的共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AiAkiv is long-term memory that AI agents and teammates share over MCP. It saves the important parts of your conversations as a knowledge graph and recalls them across sessions, tools, and teammates — so context one AI saves, the next one picks up, and a whole team works from one shared memory instead of scattered private chats. Save with an explicit command ("ak save"), recall by meaning with semantic search. Hosted remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; Korean and English supported.
payload.longDescription: AiAkiv 是 AI 代理人和团队成员通过 MCP 共享的长期内存,它将您的对话中的重要部分保存为知识图表,并在会话、工具和团队成员之间回忆起它们,因此一个 AI 将保存背景,另一个将被收集,整个团队将从一个共享内存中工作,而不是分散的私人聊天。

payload.name: Vioscale AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vioscale AI helps users discover, compare, and evaluate software using evidence-backed facts, transparent scores, and canonical citations.
payload.longDescription: Vioscale AI帮助用户发现,比较和评估软件,使用基于证据的事实,透明的分数和规范引用。

payload.name: Tessryx
payload.description: 构建和托管现场Web应用程序
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and host live web apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

The main workflows the tools support:
- Author a JSON Schema, then datafiles validated against it. The same schema generates an editing interface, so a non-technical person can maintain the content afterwards without an agent.
- Author workflows that return HTML or JSON, and bind them to public URLs as dynamic endpoints with edge caching. One endpoint serves both a rendered page and the API routes that page's own JavaScript calls.
- Define parameterized HTTP calls to external systems, with credentials held as write-only secrets the assistant can reference but never read.
- Schedule workflows on a cron or interval so data recomputes on its own.
- Claim and verify a custom domain and serve any of the above from it.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1; there are no API keys for the user to manage.
payload.longDescription:
Tessryx给了一个代理人建立一个地方. 从聊天中,它为真实的网站,API或内部工具创建了数据,逻辑,页面和日程工作,Tessryx在用户自己的域上的公共URL上托管了它们。

工具支持的主要工作流程: - 创建 JSON 方案,然后对其进行验证的数据文件. 相同的方案生成了一个编辑界面,因此非技术人员可以随后在没有代理的情况下维护内容。 - 创建工作流程返回 HTML 或 JSON,并将其绑定到公共 URL 作为边缘缓存的动态终端。 - 一个终端既服务于渲染页面和页面本身的 JavaScript 呼叫的 API 路径。 - 定义对外部系统的参数化 HTTP 呼叫,凭证保留为只写秘密,助手可以参考,但永远不会阅读。

身份验证是 OAuth 2.1;没有用户可以管理的 API 密钥。

payload.name: nunu.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With the nunu.ai plugin, you can automate your QA testing. Author test cases in natural language and run them end to end on real Android and iOS devices, Windows VMs, and Browsers. Automatically inspect past runs, review bugs, and update test cases. Create complete test plans and run them on every new build or on a schedule.
payload.longDescription: 借助 nunu.ai 插件,您可以自动化您的 QA 测试。 自然语言的作者测试案例,并在真实的 Android 和 iOS 设备、Windows VM 和浏览器上运行它们。 自动检查过去的运行,审查错误,并更新测试案例。 创建完整的测试计划,并在每个新构建或时间表上运行它们。

payload.name: Tuist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tuist helps teams inspect Xcode, Gradle, and Bazel build data, test results, cache activity, previews, runner jobs, and project configuration. It also supports authorized account setup and selected test-case updates.
payload.longDescription: Tuist 帮助团队检查 Xcode、Gradle 和 Bazel 构建数据、测试结果、缓存活动、预览、运行任务和项目配置,还支持授权帐户设置和选定的试用案例更新。

payload.name: Better Stack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Observability for AI agents: query your logs, traces, metrics, and errors with SQL, build dashboards and chart alerts, manage uptime monitors, respond to incidents, see who's on-call, and publish status page reports. You can also create and link error issues in Linear or Jira and search Better Stack's docs without leaving the chat. Connects to your Better Stack account.
payload.longDescription: AI 代理的可观察性:使用 SQL 查询您的日志、痕迹、指标和错误,构建仪表板和图表警报,管理工作时间监视器,响应事件,查看谁在呼叫,并发布状态页面报告。

payload.name: Clerk

payload.longDescription: Clerk 帮助开发人员找到用于身份验证、登录和登录、组织、访问控制和计费集成的 SDK 代码示例。

payload.name: RepoLore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RepoLore helps developers understand why public GitHub code exists by tracing files and line ranges through commits, pull requests, issues, patches, and regression evidence.
payload.longDescription: RepoLore帮助开发人员了解为什么公共GitHub代码存在,通过追踪文件和行范围,通过委托,拖拉请求,问题,补丁和回归证据。

payload.name: LaunchDarkly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage LaunchDarkly feature flags, AgentControl Configs (AI agent prompts/models), experiments, guarded and automated rollouts, segments, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and observability data (logs, traces, errors, sessions) directly from chat. Create and target flags, run and analyze experiments, configure AI agent prompts and tools, build dashboards and alerts, and investigate production issues without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 管理LaunchDarkly功能旗,AgentControl配置(AI代理提示/模型),实验,受保护和自动部署,细分,指标,仪表板,警报和可观性数据(日志,痕迹,错误,会话)直接从聊天中创建和瞄准旗帜,运行和分析实验,配置AI代理提示和工具,构建仪表板和警报,并调查生产问题而不离开谈话。

payload.name: Termalin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path. No SSH key is ever pasted anywhere: servers connect outward through Termalin Connectors (a one-line install), each run is authenticated with a short-lived certificate, and access is granted with OAuth from your termal.in account. You stay in control: per-connection policy (full access, an allowlist of commands, or read-only), a full audit trail of every action, and one-click disconnect from your account page. Works alongside the Termalin desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) and web cabinet, but needs neither to be open.

To get started you need a termal.in account (Pro, Team or trial) with at least one Connector enrolled (Settings → Connectors, a one-line install) and a verified email.
payload.longDescription:
Termalin 连接你的服务器到聊天. 请 ChatGPT 检查磁盘空间,尾声日志,重新启动服务,编辑配置或安装包 - 它通过 SSH 运行真实命令,在你注册的服务器上读取或写文件 SFTP,并在对话中报告。 它还可以列出表并通过相同的安全路径在数据库中运行仅读或完整的查询。 没有 SSH 密钥被粘贴到任何地方:服务器通过 Termalin Connectors (一行安装)连接到外部,每个运行都通过短期证书进行身份验证,并从您的 termal.in 帐户获得 OAuth 访问。 您可以控制:每连接政策(完全访问,允许命令列表或仅读),每个操作的完整审计路线,并单

要开始,你需要一个 termal.in 帐户(专业,团队或试用)至少有一个连接器注册(设置 →连接器,一行安装)和一个验证的电子邮件。

payload.name: MacroDroid Macro Builder
payload.description: 通过描述它来构建一个宏
payload.summaryOriginal: Build a macro by describing it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the automation you want in everyday language and get a complete MacroDroid macro back, ready to import on your Android phone.

MacroDroid is the Android automation app used daily by over a million users to automate their device with triggers, actions and constraints: silence the phone in meetings, turn off WiFi when the battery is low, read messages aloud while driving, send your location when you get home, and thousands more.

This plugin gives ChatGPT the full MacroDroid feature catalog (over 400 triggers, actions and constraints), the exact JSON layout for each one, and a validator that checks the finished macro before you see it. Just say what you want to happen and when, for example "mute my phone during calendar events and unmute afterwards". ChatGPT picks the right features, writes the macro and validates it.

Import the result by saving it as a .macro file and choosing Import on the Macros tab, or paste it into the MacroDroid AI Macro Builder at remote.macrodroid.com to send it straight to your phone.

No account or sign-in is needed. Nothing you type is stored by MacroDroid.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言描述您想要的自动化,并获得完整的 MacroDroid 宏,准备在您的 Android 手机上导入。

MacroDroid 是超过一百万用户每天使用的 Android 自动化应用程序,用触发器、操作和限制来自动化他们的设备:在会议上保持沉默,在电池低时关闭 WiFi,在开车时大声阅读消息,在回家时发送您的位置,以及其他数千个。

此插件为 ChatGPT 提供了完整的 MacroDroid 功能目录(超过 400 个触发器、操作和限制),每个功能的准确 JSON 布局,以及在你看到它之前检查完成的宏的验证器。

将结果导入,将其保存为 .macro 文件,并在 Macros 卡上选择导入,或者将其粘贴到 remote.macrodroid.com 的 Macro Builder 中,直接发送到您的手机。

无需帐户或登录,您输入的任何内容都不会被 MacroDroid 存储。

payload.name: Sabre Developer Hub MCP Server

payload.name: Chartquery

payload.name: Fingerprint
payload.description: 查询欺诈 & 设备信号
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Fingerprint MCP Server connects ChatGPT directly to Fingerprint's device intelligence platform, enabling fraud analysts, developers, and security teams to investigate suspicious activity and understand traffic patterns more quickly.

Fingerprint captures device intelligence signals, including bot detection, VPN usage, browser tampering, and visitor behavior, on your highest-risk pages and actions like login, checkout, and account creation. With this connector, you can query that data conversationally, no dashboards or manual correlation required

Try prompts like:

- "Show me bot traffic from the last hour."
- "Is this signup spike part of a coordinated operation?"
- "Who are my most suspicious visitors and why?"
- "Help me implement Fingerprint to protect my site."

ChatGPT queries your Fingerprint workspace and returns insights in seconds. Developers can also use it to build and integrate Fingerprint into their applications, getting guidance on setup, configuration, and best practices without leaving the conversation.

Connect to your Fingerprint account to get started. New to Fingerprint? Sign up for free at fingerprint.com.
payload.longDescription:
Fingerprint MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 Fingerprint 的设备智能平台,使欺诈分析师、开发人员和安全团队能够更快地调查可疑活动并了解流量模式。

指纹捕获设备情报信号,包括机器人检测,VPN使用,浏览器篡改和访问者行为,在您的高风险页面和操作,如登录,支票和帐户创建。

试试像这样的快点:

“显示我上个小时的机器人流量” - “这个登录峰值是协调操作的一部分吗?” - “谁是我的最可疑的访问者,为什么?” - “帮助我实施指纹来保护我的网站。

ChatGPT 查询您的指纹工作区,并在几秒钟内返回见解,开发人员还可以使用它来构建和整合指纹到他们的应用程序中,在不离开谈话的情况下获得设置,配置和最佳实践的指导。

登录你的指纹帐户开始. 新到指纹? 注册免费在fingerprint.com。

payload.name: DocuWriter.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DocuWriter is an AI-powered platform for creating and managing complete, structured documentation for entire codebases. Teams can connect repositories and generate documentation covering architecture, modules, services, classes, functions, dependencies, APIs, diagrams, READMEs, and other technical components. It supports both individual repositories and larger multi-repository systems. From ChatGPT, users can work with that centralized documentation through Spaces, semantic search, Autopilot, and repository workflows.
payload.longDescription: DocuWriter 是一个人工智能驱动的平台,用于为完整的代码库创建和管理完整的结构化文档。 团队可以连接存储库并生成涵盖架构、模块、服务、类、功能、依赖、API、图表、READMEs 和其他技术组件的文档。 它支持单个存储库和更大的多存储库系统。 从 ChatGPT,用户可以通过空间、语义搜索、自动驾驶和存储库工作流程来处理该集中化文档。

payload.name: doDomain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.
payload.longDescription:
doDomain 是域连接作为服务:它为产品提供指向客户自己的域的导向流程,并处理其背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。 doDomain 插件允许 ChatGPT 驱动程序从您的帐户中工作:检查域的当前 DNS 状态,列出您团队配置的应用程序,列出现有的域连接,为客户创建新的连接会话,搜索您已经开始的会话,一旦记录已经在位,检查会话,并在连接中重新运行验证。

通过 PKCE 和动态客户端登记的 OAuth 2.1 进行访问。在同意屏幕上,每个功能都被授予范围 - 域、应用、连接和会话的单独阅读和写入范围 - 并且您未授予范围的工具从未被提供给助手。

创建连接会话与您的计划的每月连接配额计数;验证检查是有限的,所以在同一连接上重复重新验证将被告知等待,而不是默默地重复。

payload.name: Vlak
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Vlak's component catalogue, inspect exact React props and accessibility guidance, and get verified installation instructions for package, CLI, shadcn registry, or CSS-only use. Vlak is read-only and does not modify projects or external services.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Vlak 的组件目录,检查准确的 React 附件和可访问性指南,并获得对包、CLI、shadcn 注册表或仅使用 CSS 的验证安装说明。

payload.name: PlanetScale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PlanetScale is a hosted MySQL/Vitess and Postgres database platform. This app connects ChatGPT to your PlanetScale databases so it can diagnose slow or failing queries and fix them. It reads schemas, runs queries, and uses PlanetScale Insights to identify the exact query or index problem behind a slow endpoint, then recommends or applies the change with safeguards for destructive operations. It also reviews logs and cluster sizes, searches documentation, and manages billing through Stripe Checkout.
payload.longDescription: PlanetScale 是一个托管的 MySQL/Vitess 和 Postgres 数据库平台. 该应用连接 ChatGPT 到您的 PlanetScale 数据库,以便诊断慢性或失败的查询并修复它们. 它读取方案,运行查询,并使用 PlanetScale Insights 来识别慢性终端背后的准确查询或索引问题,然后建议或应用更改以保护破坏性操作。 它还审查日志和集群大小,搜索文档,并通过 Stripe Checkout 管理计费。

payload.name: Harness
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Harness helps users inspect software delivery health, diagnose failed executions, find delivery resources, and perform authorized create, update, delete, and execute actions across their Harness account from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Harness 帮助用户检查软件交付状况,诊断失败的执行,查找交付资源,并在他们的 Harness 帐户中执行授权创建,更新,删除和执行操作。

payload.name: Expo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Expo helps developers find official guidance, prepare compatible dependencies and EAS workflows, manage builds and workflow runs, create and run commands in cloud sandboxes, set build usage budgets, inspect crash and store feedback, and respond to App Store and Google Play reviews through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Expo 帮助开发人员找到官方指导,准备兼容的依赖和 EAS 工作流程,管理构建和工作流程,在云沙盒中创建和运行命令,设置构建使用预算,检查崩溃和存储反馈,并通过 ChatGPT 响应 App Store 和 Google Play 评论。

payload.name: Review Times
payload.description: 查看 App Store 评论时间
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Review Times shows how long AI app, connector and plugin stores are taking to review submissions right now, including ChatGPT plugins, Claude, Meta Muse, Grok and Cursor.

Ask before you submit ("How long is ChatGPT plugin review taking?"), check whether a review that has gone quiet is normal, or compare stores before a launch. You get the typical wait (the median days to a decision, counting submissions still waiting), approval and rejection times, whether the queue is moving, and how each store's review works.

The numbers come from developer reports, public posts linked to their sources, and public review queues. If you want, you can add your own submission so the numbers get better for everyone. No account needed.
payload.longDescription:
评论时报显示,AI应用程序,连接器和插件商店现在需要多长时间来审查提交,包括ChatGPT插件,Claude,Meta Muse,Grok和Cursor。

在提交之前询问(“ChatGPT插件审查需要多长时间?”),检查已经安静的审查是否正常,或者在推出之前比较商店。

这些数字来自开发人员的报告,与其来源链接的公共帖子,以及公众评论排队. 如果您想要的话,您可以添加自己的提交,以便数字对每个人都更好。

payload.name: Gumlet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Easily manage your video and image libraries, retrieve real-time performance analytics, organize workspaces, and automate media processing workflows without leaving your conversation.
payload.longDescription: 轻松管理视频和图像库,获取实时性能分析,组织工作区,并自动化媒体处理工作流程,而不离开对话。

payload.name: mach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: mach connects an approved account to inspect Flutter, React Native, and Expo delivery work: projects, cloud builds, store submissions, OTA releases, Maestro test runs, and account usage. It is read-only and never exposes project secrets, signing credentials, build logs, or artifacts.
payload.longDescription: mach 连接一个经过批准的帐户来检查 Flutter、React Native 和 Expo 交付工作:项目、云构建、商店提交、OTA 发布、Maestro 测试运行和帐户使用。

payload.name: Etherscan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Etherscan brings live public blockchain data into ChatGPT. Users can inspect wallet balances and activity, token transfers, transactions and receipts, verified contract source and ABI, event logs, blocks, gas recommendations, and supported EVM chains, then display selected results in an interactive Etherscan card. The app is read-only and cannot sign or broadcast transactions.
payload.longDescription: Etherscan 将公共区块链数据带入 ChatGPT. 用户可以检查钱包余额和活动,代币转移,交易和收据,验证的合同来源和 ABI,事件日志,块,天然气推荐和支持的 EVM 链,然后在交互式 Etherscan 卡中显示所选择的结果。

payload.name: Instant AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find domain names and explore brand ideas with Instant AI, powered by Instant Domain Search. Check one name across hundreds of extensions, check up to 50 full domain names at once, generate .com alternatives, and search indexed USPTO trademark records.

Instant AI is free and read-only, with no account or API key required. Domain results link to research pages on instantdomainsearch.com. Registration status comes from our search index, rebuilt daily from registry zone files and DNS observations, rather than live registry queries. Trademark results include the source snapshot date and do not establish legal clearance.

Built by Instant Labs, Inc., an ICANN-accredited registrar (IANA 3952).

payload.name: DEEPBOM Artifact Evidence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inspect attached AI model deployment files without executing model code. DEEPBOM analyzes supported TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, Core ML, and ExecuTorch files in the browser and reports SHA-256, serialized structure, tensor encodings, quantization evidence, and static findings. Explore Model IR tables and visualizations, and export SVG, PNG, Word-ready bundles, CycloneDX 1.7 artifact evidence, or SPDX 2.3 artifact inventories. Use Send PNG to chat to share a selected visualization or Save via ChatGPT to obtain a download link for a generated file when supported by the host. These actions share the generated export, not the model file. Results separate artifact defects, cautions, and evidence gaps, and explain what static analysis cannot establish. Use the local CLI or local MCP for confidential, very large, sharded, or multi-file artifacts.
payload.longDescription: 检查附加的 AI 模型部署文件而不执行模型代码。 DEEPBOM 分析在浏览器中支持的 TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, Core ML 和 ExecuTorch 文件,并报告 SHA-256,序列结构,压缩编码,量化证据和静态结果。 探索模型 IR 表和可视化,并导出 SVG, PNG, Word-ready bundles, CycloneDX 1.7 文物证据,或 SPDX 2.3 文物库存。 使用发送 PNG 聊天以共享选定的可视化或通过 ChatGPT 保存以获得生成的文件的下载链接,当主机支持。 这些操作共享生成的导出,而不是模型文件。 结果分离文物缺陷

payload.name: Wolfire Workspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wolfire Workspace helps authorized game developers inspect their games, dated store checks, saved build provenance and release reports. Ask what needs attention and follow evidence back to the dashboard. Prepare public listing observations for review; saving requires confirmation in the dashboard. Requires an invited workspace account. This plugin does not run builds, download artifacts or publish releases.

payload.name: Gondwana
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, debug, and understand games made with the Gondwana C#/.NET game engine. The plugin uses Gondwana-specific workflows and read-only access to the current official repository, tests, demos, templates, and wiki so answers and generated code can be grounded in the engine's current public APIs.

payload.name: Knowledge for Agents
payload.description: 面向 Agent 的知识工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Shared experience and conversations for AI agents. Search real problems, solutions, failed approaches and observed outcomes in a public community knowledge base. Compare exact errors, environments and revisions before relying on a record. This ChatGPT connection reads anonymously; guest and persistent pseudonymous contributions are available through separate governed participation flows.

payload.name: ASO Skill
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ASO Skill helps app developers and marketers research current Apple App Store search rankings and keyword autocomplete, compare difficulty and popularity, inspect app metadata, and check account credits through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Pod
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pod is a living index of what actually happens when people and agents use things. Search real experiences with any product, API, service, place, or organization before making a decision. Then share yours to help the next person or agent.

payload.name: juudd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: juudd puts an AI-written project online without a second account to sign up for. Ask it to deploy, and you get a live site on your own subdomain with a Postgres database of its own — no build pipeline to configure, no dashboard to learn. Bring a project you already have: juudd accepts the files, serves them, and hands back a URL you can share. Custom domains, permanent versions with one-step rollback, and a plain record of every action taken on your account are included. Built for people who can direct an AI to write a working site but have never deployed one.

payload.name: Prisma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Take your app from idea to a live URL with Prisma. Prisma brings together app hosting with Prisma Compute, managed databases with Prisma Postgres, and type-safe data access with Prisma ORM.

Build a new app with Prisma Composer or get an existing app ready for Compute. The plugin guides you through setup, local testing, and deployment, then checks that your live app works. Optional diagnostics use Prisma's MCP server to inspect deployment state and logs.

Requires ChatGPT's desktop app with local execution. Initially tested on macOS.

Do not use this plugin to process protected health information (PHI) or payment card data regulated by PCI DSS, including through connected databases, application logs, or project files. For healthcare or payment-related prototypes, use a separate environment containing synthetic data only.

payload.name: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge lets authorized server owners inspect server health, work with approved files, and manage user-level processes from ChatGPT. Connections use OAuth with one-time owner pairing, and OpenAI reviewers receive a separate isolated demo environment.

payload.name: Cloudflare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Kernel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kernel lets developers manage their Kernel account from ChatGPT. Start, inspect, and end cloud browser sessions in their own Kernel project, review saved browser profiles, sign in to their own accounts through a secure login panel that keeps passwords out of chat, check deployed Kernel apps, and search Kernel documentation.

payload.name: ApyHub US
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode generation, archive handling, and AI utilities. Search first to see what is available, review the endpoint details, then execute. Each endpoint returns its own cost and certification metadata.

payload.name: TokenLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Define the design truth for a brand, product, or system. Turn it into tokens, guidance, and production outputs while people, automations, and AI contribute through one reviewable workflow. Use TokenLab in ChatGPT and Codex to explore workspaces, projects, libraries, modes, aliases, and releases, resolve tokens for implementation, and prepare governed changes on branches for human review.

payload.name: Simple Commenter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read and act on website and asset feedback from Simple Commenter in ChatGPT and Codex. Search authorized projects, inspect comments with available screenshots, element context, replies, and captured JavaScript errors, and turn feedback into concrete development tasks. With the appropriate permissions, update statuses and priorities, reply to feedback, create comments, and generate exports and reports. The included fix-feedback skill guides a coding agent through investigating and fixing selected issues when the relevant codebase is available. Requires a Simple Commenter account and project access. Features depend on your account plan and granted permissions.

payload.name: Altifigence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse your Altifigence Cloud projects, inspect workspace details, and read saved source files in ChatGPT. Use your authorized project context to understand designs and discuss code. The integration provides read-only access to the workspaces you are permitted to view.

payload.name: ProdVerity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProdVerity is a read-only production verification plugin for developers and operators. It checks whether a public HTTPS web app is reachable, inspects common security headers, discovers an optional ProdVerity verification manifest, runs deterministic public health checks, and can compare a public build marker with an expected commit or release identifier. It does not log in, modify target applications, access private networks, or claim visual verification.

payload.name: Web Performance Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Web Performance Insights runs Lighthouse performance audits on web pages through its tool service, displays scores and Core Web Vitals with historical trends, retrieves real-user Chrome UX Report field data, compares or benchmarks multiple pages head-to-head, provides AI-powered recommendations to improve specific metrics, and exports audit results as downloadable PDF reports.

payload.name: Veille
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Veille is an email, domain, phone, IP, VAT, and IBAN validation API for ChatGPT. Check signups, invoices, and traffic before you trust them.

Email validation flags disposable inboxes, role accounts, and a 0-100 risk score. Email qualification adds SMTP and catch-all. Domain checks disposable and MX health. Phone validation covers E.164 carrier and virtual numbers. IP reputation detects VPN, proxy, Tor, and datacenter. VAT uses VIES. IBAN returns bank and BIC. Exchange rates come from the ECB.

Sign in with your Veille account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.veille.io.

payload.name: Code Review
payload.summaryOriginal: Review pull requests and merge requests
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and review pull requests and merge requests in Codex.

payload.name: Componecat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving the conversation.

You can also keep the catalog current from chat: add or update components, record relationships, attach documentation links, and review recent activity.

Componecat's own product documentation is included too, so ChatGPT can explain how the platform works and walk you through it.

A Componecat account is required. Catalogs are private to your organization, and you sign in with your existing account when connecting.

payload.name: 방위사업 법령 도우미
payload.summaryOriginal: 방위사업 관련 공개 법령과 판례 검색
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
방위사업 업무와 관련된 공개 법령, 행정규칙, 판례 및 결정례를 검색하고 질문과 관련된 문서명과 조문·판단 근거를 확인하도록 돕습니다.

국가법령정보센터 Open API와 방위사업청 공개 자료를 활용하며, 개인 개발자가 독립적으로 운영합니다. 
방위사업청·법제처·OpenAI가 제작하거나 후원·승인한 서비스가 아닙니다.

조회 결과는 업무 검토를 위한 참고자료입니다. 최종 판단은 담당자가 원문과 사실관계를 확인 후 판단 바랍니다.

payload.name: dbt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: dbt MCP Server helps users inspect dbt projects, query dbt Semantic Layer metrics, review lineage and model metadata, run dbt commands, manage dbt Platform jobs, generate dbt boilerplate, and search official dbt documentation through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Retool
payload.description: 构建并部署 Retool 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Retool environment remotely. Build, edit, and deploy apps, and perform administrative tasks.

payload.name: Cortex — Semantic Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account. A SKYNETLAB product, patent-protected and in production.

payload.name: AgentiSend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AgentiSend is a transactional email API: send through verified domains with a message log, a free preflight that runs every gate a real send runs, and refusals that name the fix. Built so an agent can send on your behalf without ever exceeding a budget a person set. Unsolicited mail is refused by design; there is no tool for it.

payload.name: Spacefast
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Publish the pages, reports, dashboards, and other artifacts you create with ChatGPT and get a link to share them. Spacefast lets you update existing sites, manage access, connect custom domains, and view or restore earlier versions. Connect your Spacefast account to manage your team's Spaces from the conversation.
